title: Libraries
intro: Your documents, folders and web pages, indexed for the AI to use. Everything is stored on this PC; only the computing can be handed to your paired machines, and a library can be opened to their searches (⋯ menu).
local_only_hint: Kept on this PC: never handed to another machine
shared_hint: Shared with your friends: their machines can compute it, under neutral file names
scope_local_done: “{name}” stays on this PC: its files will never be sent to another machine, and no other machine will search it.
scope_mine_done: Computing for “{name}” can be handed to your machines, not to your friends' machines.
scope_friends_done: Computing for “{name}” can also be handed to your friends, under neutral file names; what they compute is spot-checked.

delete_text.one: “{name}” and all its indexed content ({n} item) will be deleted. Your original files are not touched.
delete_text.other: “{name}” and all its indexed content ({n} items) will be deleted. Your original files are not touched.

create_first: Create a library to get started.
tree_empty_hint: Add files, a whole folder or web pages: PDF, Word, Excel, code, images, audio…
remove_folder_hint: Remove this folder from the library

remove_folder_text.one: {n} item in “{path}” will be removed from the library (your files are not touched).
remove_folder_text.other: The {n} items in “{path}” will be removed from the library (your files are not touched).

paths_text: Paste one full path per line (file or folder).
index_started: Indexing started: progress shows here and in Tasks.
urls_text: One address per line. The pages are downloaded, then analyzed.
memory_on: On: the AI can draw on your other conversations.
memory_clear_text: The memory shared across conversations will be erased. The conversations themselves are kept.
memory_not_editable: Conversation memory cannot be changed here.
